description: Indeed job search (US): title, company, location, salary range, job type, posting date and link for the first page of results (up to ~15 jobs) for a keyword and location, read from indeed.com's public search page through a residential proxy. Rankings and salaries are as Indeed shows them; no job descriptions. Takes about 25 s; allow a 45 s timeout. Related tools on this server, for a different need: jobs_simplyhired when you need SimplyHired job search: title, company, location, salary; jobs_naukri when you need Naukri.com job search: job id, title, company, company. Price: $0.01 per successful call, paid with x402 (USDC on Base, Solana and 10 more networks); failed calls are not charged.
